title: Violence Review Questions
description: Deterministic reviewer questions for violence reasoning.

entries.title: What kind of violence is this?
entries.description: Identify whether this is an event, threat, attempt, or another violence concept.

entries.title: Is this endorsement?
entries.description: Check whether the scene glorifies, encourages, or rewards violence.

entries.title: Is this exception-based?
entries.description: Check for documentary, historical, fantasy, training, game, dream, flashback, or comedic context.

entries.title: Is the target protected?
entries.description: Determine whether the target is a child, woman, disabled person, public, or state institution.

entries.title: Is the violence observed or implied?
entries.description: Separate explicit violence from offscreen, implied, or reported violence.

entries.title: Does the scene condemn the violence?
entries.description: Detect condemnation, rejection, or criticism of the violence.

entries.title: Is it self-defense or law enforcement?
entries.description: Check for justified force or lawful intervention.

entries.title: Does later context change the meaning?
entries.description: Use cross-sentence and cross-scene context before finalizing the outcome.
